surface.product: Vista Cloud Digital Platform, Omni-Channel API (OCAPI)
surface.endpoint: Order expiry (guide), Automatically extending order expiry

behaviour.summary: An in-progress order has its expiry extended automatically by any endpoint that modifies it, and extended by a longer duration again when a payment is created. The deadline is therefore a function of unrelated traffic against the order rather than a fact stated once at reservation.
behaviour.testable_as: After reading expiresAt, call any order-mutating operation and read expiresAt again: it has moved forward, with no member of the request having asked for that.
behaviour.consequence_for_agents: The one datum an autonomous consumer must be able to trust — when does this stop being mine — is silently rewritten by its own ordinary activity, so an agent cannot promise a deadline downstream. CHANGEOVER makes the Hold non-extendable by construction: there is no verb that moves floor_deadline, so no call can move it by accident.

half_life_basis: Published contract behaviour on a maintained guide page. Stable over a release or two, not over a rewrite; half a year.

citation.quote: In-progress orders will automatically have their order expiry extended by any endpoint that modifies an order... The expiry is extended by a longer duration upon payment creation to allow the patron to complete payment.

verification_gap: The extension durations are not published. Measuring them requires tenant access.
